messages:
martin: Heads-up — code freeze for 1.8.0 in ~2h (15:00 UTC). If you need a late merge, post PR link + short reason + rollback plan here. Exceptions close 30m before freeze.

sara: Quick Q — is the changelog PR ready? I have a tiny docs bump (#5421).

kevin: @sara please rebase onto release/1.8 and ping me once CI is green.

deploy-bot: Scheduled freeze: 2026-03-17 15:00:00 UTC. Last-merge cutoff: 14:30:00 UTC.

olga: Requesting exception for PR #5409 — hotfix: kv-cache off-by-one. Impacts prod SLOs for batching paths. Tests flaky but I have a rollback patch queued (PR #5410). Need to ship before cutoff.

kevin: Can you add a minimal regression test? If CI passes and rollback is trivial, I can approve the exception. Also include a one-liner in changelog.

olga: Adding a small unit test now, will push in ~10m. Rollback is: git revert --no-edit <commit> then cherry-pick rollback fix on main.

ci-bot: build 1892 — staging e2e: PASSED, unit: PASSED, flake-detection: 0 failures. (olga/pr/5409)

kevin: CI green. Reviewed diff, it's small and scoped. Approving exception contingent on squash merge and changelog line. :thumbsup:

martin: Approved exception for #5409 under conditions listed by @kevin. @release-manager please file the exception record and note the rollback steps.

release-manager: Exception ticket created: infra-EX-327. Added to release notes draft and annotated with rollback steps and CI link. Will hold RC tag until 15:05 UTC to confirm no further exceptions.

sara: Merged #5421 (docs) into release/1.8 — small changelog tweak included.

martin: Thanks everyone. If no additional exceptions, we plan to tag RC at 15:05 UTC and start the canary rollout. :tada:
